slots.palette: warm festive pastel palette with deep red and gold accents
slots.setting: a Lunar New Year night street feast for cute animals
slots.decorations: Light wood, red paper cut-outs with simple flower shapes, small potted tangerine trees and a few firecracker strings around the edges of the screen.
slots.kitchen: a festive kitchen doorway with a red bead curtain
slots.loop_interior: a low round light wooden table with a small bowl of tangerines
slots.foods: a dumpling, a spring roll, a tangerine, a sesame ball or a small slice of nian gao
slots.counter: a light wooden counter with red lacquer trim
slots.board_surface: a pale wooden table top framed with a thin red lacquer border, lit by warm lantern light
slots.obstacles: a small tangerine, a red envelope and a little lantern
slots.mood: festive, joyful and warm, with everyone happily eating
slots.night_sky: a deep blue night sky with soft distant firework sparkles, only around the outer edges
slots.light_sources: strings of round red lanterns along the edges and above both belts, and small gold lanterns on the counter
slots.effects: a few soft firework bursts in the top corners, gently swaying lantern tassels, and a few drifting gold sparkles at the edges
